BS19.title: Embodied Intelligence
BS19.description: Embodied intelligence scenarios cover humanoid robots, service robots, industrial collaborative robots, medical/surgical robots, autonomous-driving embodied systems, and robot swarms — intelligent agents with physical bodies and perception-decision capabilities, facing VLA model adversarial attacks, teleoperation channel hijacking, robot middleware vulnerabilities, physical harm and functional safety, swarm coordination loss-of-control, and physical-world prompt injection.
